description: This file defines the OrderTotal class, which models an order total component (such as shipping, tax, etc.) in an e-commerce system. It includes fields for amount, code, title, text, and relations to Order, using JPA annotations for ORM.

classes.name: OrderTotal
classes.description: A JPA entity representing a total component of an order (e.g., shipping, tax). It contains metadata and value fields, with ORM mappings, and relationships to the Order class.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of this order total.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of this order total.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the order total.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the order total.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Returns the text description of the order total.

methods.name: setText
methods.description: Sets the text description of the order total.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the monetary value associated with this order total.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the monetary value associated with this order total.

methods.name: getModule
methods.description: Returns the module name related to this total.

methods.name: setModule
methods.description: Sets the module name related to this total.

methods.name: getSortOrder
methods.description: Returns the display order of this total.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the display order of this total.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the associated Order object.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Associates this total with an Order object.

methods.name: getOrderTotalCode
methods.description: Returns the code (e.g., SHIPPING, TAX) associated with this total.

methods.name: setOrderTotalCode
methods.description: Sets the code (e.g., SHIPPING, TAX) for this total.

methods.name: getOrderValueType
methods.description: Returns the type of the order value (e.g., ONE_TIME).

methods.name: setOrderValueType
methods.description: Sets the type of the order value.

methods.name: getOrderTotalType
methods.description: Returns the total type (e.g., subtotal, grand total).

methods.name: setOrderTotalType
methods.description: Sets the total type.
